'''Isu-Sim''' was a manufacturer of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] systems.

Their best known products were the belt of one hundred twenty-three massive [[SSP06 hyperdrive generator]]s which propelled the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to a class four [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] speed. They also produced the original [[SSP05 hyperdrive generator/Legends|SSP05 hyperdrive generator]] which [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] later modified for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
